checks_performed: Read all changed C/C++ source diffs and full current examples. Compared original and new token streams under per-file identifier renames, ignoring comments/whitespace and then manually reviewing inserted braces for unchanged control flow and scope.

Manually resolved token-comparison exceptions: public Line::Result::ready and std::array::data() retain API names; protocol-test adjacent string literals concatenate to identical output; parsed_end and poll_result correctly distinguish parse-end and poll-return roles.
Inspected CMake diff: same foreach target names and target_link_libraries tokens in same order; only line breaks/indentation changed.

Reviewed wire commands, pin numbers, register addresses, masks, timing thresholds, parser limits, callback/main ordering, serial deadline handling, BME280 arithmetic operation order, and kernel open/read/IRQ/unbind lifetime and cleanup paths; all retained.

Scanned every affected catalog page for renamed identifiers and inspected inline C/C++/GDB fragments, sample protocol/output strings, shared public Device/Request and kernel reader fields, and literal command flags/paths/consumer labels.

Ran actual bundled arm-none-eabi-objdump against rebuilt blink_registers, button_irq and uart_device ELFs: led_on store stays 0x100001e8; gpio_isr W1C store stays 0x100001ea (offset +10), leaf frame unchanged; UART GPIO coprocessor operation stays mcrr at 0x100005b2.
Rechecked current source/prose after root repairs. No residual accidental literal substitutions, stale GDB led/mask names or old changed-flag labels found in final targeted scan.
9.3 third-party frozen kernel C excerpts retain original tabs, braces and spelling verbatim; only our driver pointer references change.

findings_resolved.finding: BME280 SPI main still used Bus::cs after declaration rename.
findings_resolved.resolution: All three uses now Bus::chip_select_pin; source and full Pico compile checked by root.

findings_resolved.finding: poll return and parse-end pointer had misleading generated names.
findings_resolved.resolution: Serial::ready uses poll_result; GPIO offset parser uses parsed_end. I/O transfer counts retain transferred_bytes.

findings_resolved.finding: Broad Markdown substitution damaged newline/CR escapes, uname flags, literal GPIO consumer labels, /proc/self/maps and expected output, and confused kernel seen with client events_received.
findings_resolved.resolution: Root regenerated prose from the original baseline with protected literals and contextual short-name changes; all reported literal and public-field regressions rechecked and restored.

findings_resolved.finding: Debugger commands and exception diagram/disassembly comment retained old identifiers.
findings_resolved.resolution: 3.2 and 3.3 GDB commands use led_pin/led_mask; 4.4 diagram and disassembly comment use edge_pending.

findings_resolved.finding: 3.3 described baseline while loop as single-line after formatting expanded it.
findings_resolved.resolution: Instruction now says entire while loop.

findings_resolved.resolution: 8.3/8.4 now use button_device; kernel teardown comment also updated.
